sourceTitle: Income Tax Department — ITR-1 (Sahaj) FAQs on advance tax
notes: Advance tax is statutory when estimated annual tax liability after TDS/TCS exceeds ₹10,000. Instalments are due quarterly for non-corporate taxpayers.
assumptions: Applicable to individual resident taxpayers whose estimated total income tax liability for the financial year (after deducting TDS and TCS) exceeds ₹10,000 under Section 208.
Follows the quarterly statutory schedule for non-corporate taxpayers: 15% by 15 June, 45% by 15 September, 75% by 15 December, and 100% by 15 March under Section 211.
limitations: Resident senior citizens (aged 60 years or older) having no business or professional income are entirely exempt from advance tax under Section 207.
Does not calculate penal interest under Section 234B (interest for defaults in payment of advance tax) or Section 234C (interest for deferment of installments).
Eligible presumptive taxation assessees (Sections 44AD / 44ADA) paying 100% advance tax in a single installment by 15 March are not modeled.
Estimated schedule for planning purposes; consult official CBDT challan guidelines for tax deposit via e-Pay Tax.
disclaimer: This calculator uses the rules/data published by Income Tax Department for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27). Estimated result based on the inputs and assumptions provided. Educational tool only; not legal or filing advice. Check official guidance for your specific situation.
